workLog.action: Read issue and linked pull request discourse
workLog.outcome: Read issue 4547, duplicate PR 4621, and PR 4721 review and workflow discussions.
Current main classified empty transient failures but performed no context-fetch retry.
Added three attempts, a 210-second shared budget, header-aware waits, permanent-auth short-circuiting, and redacted diagnostics.
Covered eventual success, exhausted retries, auth and permission rejection, malformed and empty output, whitespace-only output, and secret redaction.
DevOps review passed. GPT-5.6 Sol found and verified fixes for whitespace context, shared deadlines, permission fallback, and stdout redaction.
Fresh-context review prevented three false-success paths. The shared deadline belongs at the context boundary, whitespace is empty infrastructure output, and tests must inject dynamic secret values.

Remote issue and spec failures now set infrastructure_failure. Empty issue output also fails closed. A job-level absolute deadline deducts elapsed setup and preserves model invocation plus finalization time.

workLog.action: Resolved recursive Critical and High review findings
workLog.outcome: Rejected partial failed output, recovered only through complete fallback transports, failed closed on every missing or empty context, stopped permanent authentication fallbacks, redacted model diagnostics, honored HTTP 429 Retry-After, and bounded Copilot termination with a five-second kill grace.
Independent DevOps and GPT-5.6 Sol reviews reported no remaining Critical or High findings across context, invocation, action, workflow, and tests.

Applied the shared token-shape redactor with include_hex disabled before context files, GitHub outputs, artifact contexts, persisted prompts, and model argv. Final recursive DevOps and GPT-5.6 Sol reviews passed.

workLog.action: Resolved recursive sink and stale-verdict findings
workLog.outcome: Added shared wrapper and assignment redaction, parse-before-redact handling for structured GitHub responses, collision-safe outputs, direct-action deadlines, failed-process verdict rejection, and stale output removal. Final DevOps and GPT-5.6 Sol reviews found no Critical or High issues.

Moved direct-action deadline arithmetic from workflow YAML into a tested Python helper. Exact inherited-deadline validation rejects negative, non-finite, scientific, and malformed values. ADR-006 reports zero run-block violations, and recursive DevOps review reports no Critical or High findings.

workLog.action: Resolved structured assignment truncation and suffix leak reviews
workLog.outcome: Bounded credential assignment redaction to scalar values, preserved trailing JSON and prose fields, and covered raw and escaped JSON with one through six backslashes before inner quotes. Recursive GPT-5.6 Sol review reports no Critical or High findings.

Made credential namespace separator alternatives disjoint in the canonical and bundled redactors, added escaped-separator and adversarial long-input coverage, proved the new regression fails against the pre-fix source and passes after restore, and reran redactor, parity, false-positive, Ruff, and security review checks.

workLog.action: Resolved token-only URL userinfo review findings
workLog.outcome: Changed canonical and bundled URL userinfo redaction to mask credentials before @ even without a password separator. Added token-only positive coverage, URL-without-userinfo negative coverage, proved the new token-only test fails against the pre-fix source and passes after restore, and reran redactor, parity, false-positive, Ruff, and security review checks.
